# Zoom Chat

<!-- WARNING: THIS FILE WAS AUTOGENERATED! DO NOT EDIT! -->

Build Chatbots, integrate using APIs and webhooks, and create applications for [Zoom Chat](https://www.zoom.com/en/products/chat/).

![](/img/teamchat.png)

## Platform

-   Use Chat, Channel, and Message APIs and webhooks
-   Accelerate Chatbot development with Zoom Rivet
-   Design with Zoom Chatbot Card Builder
-   Build UIs inside Zoom Chat with Apps SDK
-   Post to channels easily with incoming webhooks
-   Migrate your Slackbot to Zoom Chat
-   Create for your Zoom account or publish to the Zoom App Marketplace

## Sample apps

-   [Standup Chatbot using Zoom Rivet](https://github.com/zoom/rivet-javascript-sample)
-   [Unsplash Chatbot](https://github.com/zoom/unsplash-chatbot)
